note: Requested retained capacities of 58 register-allocation member containers, two public dense-register lists and nested vector/SmallVector storage, observed at pass return when total capacity changes. Inline payload is counted once via enclosing object capacity. Excludes private dense-index tables, FlatKeyMap storage, temporary locals, other passes and allocator rounding. Pass identities are addresses plus thread IDs, not destruction-tracked lifetimes; maxima are independent and their sum is NOT a simultaneous peak.
